title: 2023 Score #172 Trey Lance San Francisco 49ers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Score sports trading card features Trey Lance of the San Francisco 49ers. The card is part of the base set and has the card number 172. It is perfect for any fan of the National Football League (NFL) and collectors of sports trading cards. 

The card is manufactured by Panini and does not come with an autograph. It is a great addition to any collection and is from the 2023 season. Get your hands on this card today and add it to your sports trading card collection!
